item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem:
During lunch at school, Meera notices her friend Arjun throwing half of his uneaten roti and dal into the dustbin. Meera wants to explain why wasting food should be avoided. Which of the following reasons best connects avoiding food waste with the work of people who bring food to our plate ( )
A. Food should not be wasted because it is always expensive to buy
B. Farmers spend months growing crops, and many workers help transport and cook food before it reaches our plate, so wasting food disrespects their time and effort
C. Food waste is acceptable if the food tastes bad, because taste matters more than effort
D. Only farmers grow food, so no other community member's effort is involved

options.A: Food should not be wasted because it is always expensive to buy
options.B: Farmers spend months growing crops, and many workers help transport and cook food before it reaches our plate, so wasting food disrespects their time and effort
